review: Slow LDO-enable and FET-drain control net. The 40 mm planner cap is not an electrical rule. A 41.82 mm, 0.2 mm trace is acceptable for candidate routing; estimated trace drop is below 0.06 mV at a conservative 0.55 mA pull-up current. Opposite-side RF projection is separated by both inner GND planes. Actual final geometry, return coverage, waveform and supplier checks remain required.
